feedback: Prompt the limit aloud: 'This shows the upward push, but it is not real rock and not real heat — real magma glows because it is extremely hot.'
activities.intendedInsight: An eruption is driven by an upward push from built-up pressure — but the analogy is limited: the fizz is not real molten rock and not real heat.
learnerActions: Watch or run a classic bicarbonate/vinegar reaction or a shaken fizzy-bottle release to feel how built-up pressure pushes material UP and out.
State explicitly how this model is and is NOT like a real volcano.
activities.title: Pressure-push model as a flagged analogy
